units.name: Department of Management
units.evidence: The official bachelor's catalogue explicitly places Logistics and Supply Chain Management in the Department of Management, College of Business Administration. The catalogue also lists engineering programmes and their departments; none of those listings establishes an industrial-engineering or operations unit.

decisions.reason: Imported IS and DA label is information systems/data analytics, not an operations unit. The official catalogue lists Information Systems and Business Analytics separately from the Management department that houses logistics and supply chain.
SCM and Logistics is the subject label; the official catalogue names its department as Department of Management.

sources.note: Read the full official catalogue in Chrome, including all business and engineering entries and university identity footer.

limitations: The review establishes the named department hosting the listed logistics programme; it does not establish that all research groups across the university were enumerated.
